Supporting Growth for Emerging Beverage Brands

"The Calienté Spirits Expo was created to give emerging spirit brands direct access to the people who can help grow their business. Instead of spending months trying to secure introductions, we're bringing distributors, buyers, media, influencers, retailers, and consumers together under one roof. The relationships built at this event can accelerate a brand's growth dramatically."
, CEO and Co-Founder, Fast Moving Consumer Goods, Inc.

"Our focus is creating a true business-building event for emerging spirit brands. Attendees don't just pour samples; they meet distributors, retailers, restaurant operators, media representatives, and consumers who can become long-term supporters of their brand. A limited number of exhibitor spaces remain available. Beverage brands interested in showcasing products and networking with buyers, distributors, retailers, media, influencers, and consumers are encouraged to reserve their space immediately. 619-727-9657
About Fast Moving Consumer Goods, Inc.

Fast Moving Consumer Goods is a nationwide ecosystem created to educate and support new founders, celebrities, CEOs and doctors engaged in the formulation, manufacturing, launching and scaling of their fast moving consumer goods brands, including beverages, beauty products, nutritional supplements, and spirits. FMCG provides beverage development and formulation, beverage manufacturing, nutritional supplement development and production, beauty product development, TikTok Live Selling, retail sales, and wholesale distribution management. FMCG is the nation's first fast moving consumer goods incubator. Both Sandro Piancone and Jorge Olson are available for podcast and speaking engagements.
